name: 57-t20-higher-cap-plain-path
incident: 2026-10-07 negative of scenario 55: a camera whose cap reaches night_gain keeps the plain rule
description: The scenario-55 dusk on the same T20 isp_info dump, but with an analog cap of 160 units (32x = 8192, the T31 sample's value). At 87.6 % integration time the index reaches 7174, so night_gain 4096 is reachable and the reachable-maximum rule stays inert: the switch to night comes from the plain `s > night_gain` path, exactly as before, and no warning is logged.
